key_decisions.rationale: Retains copy/shadow, Moses, mountain and pattern.
key_decisions.before: They serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things. For when Moses was about to erect the tent, he was instructed by God, saying, “See that you make everything according to the pattern that was shown you on the mountain.”
key_decisions.after: They serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, just as Moses was warned when he was about to complete the tent: “See that you make everything according to the pattern shown to you on the mountain.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: They serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things. For when Moses was about to erect the tent, he was instructed by God, saying, “See that you make everything according to the pattern that was shown you on the mountain.”

key_decisions.before: For if that first covenant had been faultless, there would have been no occasion to look for a second.
key_decisions.after: For if that first covenant had been faultless, no place would have been sought for a second.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For if that first covenant had been faultless, there would have been no occasion to look for a second.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned ‘them’ reading and retains both named houses.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps handholding exodus image, failure and divine response.
key_decisions.before: not like the covenant that I made with their fathers on the day when I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, for they did not continue in my covenant, and so I showed no concern for them, declares the Lord.
key_decisions.after: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors on the day I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they did not remain in my covenant, and I disregarded them, says the Lord.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps universal knowledge and social range.
key_decisions.before: And they will not teach, each person his neighbor and each one his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest.
key_decisions.after: No one will teach a fellow citizen or a brother or sister, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know me, from the least to the greatest.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps aging/disappearance imagery and temporal process.
key_decisions.before: In speaking of a new covenant, he makes the first obsolete. And what is becoming obsolete and growing old is ready to vanish away.
key_decisions.after: By speaking of a “new” covenant, he has made the first obsolete; and what is becoming obsolete and growing old is near disappearance.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: In speaking of a new covenant, he makes the first obsolete. And what is becoming obsolete and growing old is ready to vanish away.
